name: Allpass1
description: First-order allpass filter from the RMEQ suite. Passes all frequencies but introduces a frequency-dependent phase shift around the corner frequency. Useful as a phase-shaping component in custom filters and decorrelation. From sc3-plugins RMEQSuiteUGens.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Corner frequency in Hz where the phase shift is centred

name: Allpass2
description: Second-order allpass filter from the RMEQ suite. Passes all frequencies but introduces a phase shift; rq controls the bandwidth/sharpness of the phase transition. Useful as a building block for parametric EQ and decorrelation. From sc3-plugins RMEQSuiteUGens.

inputs.name: rq
inputs.description: Reciprocal-Q (bandwidth/freq) — higher values widen the phase transition

name: RMEQ
description: Regalia-Mitra parametric EQ section using two cascaded allpass filters. Provides clean boost/cut at a centre frequency with adjustable bandwidth (rq) and gain (k). The Regalia-Mitra topology has flat unity-gain reference and adjustable peak gain. From sc3-plugins RMEQSuiteUGens.

inputs.name: rq
inputs.description: Reciprocal-Q (bandwidth/freq) — smaller values give a narrower peak

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: Gain coefficient — positive values boost, negative cut. 0 is unity (no effect)

name: RMShelf
description: Regalia-Mitra low/high shelving filter. Provides clean boost/cut above (or below) the corner frequency. Sign of k selects shelf direction and gain. From sc3-plugins RMEQSuiteUGens.

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: Shelf gain coefficient — positive values boost, negative cut. 0 is unity

name: RMShelf2
description: Second-order Regalia-Mitra shelving filter — sharper transition than RMShelf. Provides clean boost/cut with a steeper slope around the corner frequency. From sc3-plugins RMEQSuiteUGens.

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: Shelf gain coefficient — positive values boost, negative cut. 0 is unity

name: Spreader
description: Stereo spreader using a constant-Q filter bank to fan the input across the stereo field. theta controls the fan width (in radians, 0..pi/2) and filtsPerOctave controls the density of the filter bank. Outputs 2 channels. From sc3-plugins RMEQSuiteUGens.

inputs.name: theta
inputs.description: Spread angle in radians (0..pi/2). Higher values widen the stereo image

inputs.name: filtsPerOctave
inputs.description: Filters per octave in the spreading bank — higher values give a denser, smoother spread
